title: Holy priest: no shield on an Arms warrior tanking in Defensive Stance

rules.desc: Holy priest casts no Power Word: Shield on a Defensive-Stance Arms warrior above the critical band in combat
rules.why_expect: NOT a before-case for #1553: Defensive Stance reads as TANK at AiFactory.cpp:503 (GetRoleFromStanceOrGear :491-515, used by GetPlayerRoles :597-611), and with the solo warrior as the only tank HasOtherTank (:520-576) finds no other tank, so the stance is read on t1106g and on the fix alike and no shield lands above the critical band. Expected PASS for both builds. #1553 reproduces only with a second tank in the group (PRI-PWS-DEF-ARMS-2TANK) or with a non-tank role (PRI-PWS-BOT-WARRIOR-CONTROL is the matching control); before-r2 on t1106f saw 0 shields. Needs the player visible to the bots (setup check player_visible): with the GM hidden the priest never answers the player and this rule passes for the wrong reason

rules.desc: Precondition: Defensive Stance (aura 71) stays on the player through the fight, so the shield rule above is about this stance
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the stance is read by ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:491-504 (GetRoleFromStanceOrGear); setup check player_stance proves it at the start, this proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the runner re-casts the stance and excludes time without it
